title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements: Fleet Late Balance Fee Assessment
content:
**Product:** Vehicle Purchase Agreements, deal type Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement.
**Subject:** the monthly late balance fee on a delivered fleet deal that still carries a balance due.

## 1. Which deals this rule covers

For a Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement whose buyer's service account is not on credit hold this policy sets the late balance fee, and only for such a deal. A fleet deal whose buyer's service account is on credit hold, and every other deal type, keeps the base fee: the deal type's late balance fee rate per month multiplied by the balance due standing at the moment of assessment, rounded to the cent and never less than the deal type's minimum late balance fee, together with the base assessment timing. Every late balance fee, this one included, is posted under the charge code late_balance_fee with the calendar month of assessment as the billing month.

| Deal | Late balance fee set by |
|---|---|
| Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement, buyer's service account not on credit hold | this fleet late balance fee policy |
| Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement, buyer's service account on credit hold | the base late balance fee of the deal type |
| Any other deal type of the Vehicle Purchase Agreements | the base late balance fee of the deal type |

## 2. When the fee is fixed

The fleet late balance fee is fixed only after the home delivery fee posted on the deal has been checked against the fleet home delivery fee and any excess reversed.

The fleet late balance fee is not worked out until the manufacturer fleet incentive owed on a qualifying unit stands credited on the deal.

Put another way, the fleet late balance fee for a deal is worked out only once the deal's home delivery fee has been checked against the fleet home delivery fee with any excess reversed, and only while any manufacturer fleet incentive owed on that unit already stands credited on the deal.

## 3. Posting the fee: `post_fleet_late_fee_7ed43dd7`

**Capability.** The tool assesses the late balance fee for one billing month on one delivered fleet deal. It books one charge under the charge code late_balance_fee, carrying the billing month assessed and dated the handling date. The deal's balance due rises by the fee, and the buyer sees the late balance fee for that month on the deal statement.

**How it is invoked.** `post_fleet_late_fee_7ed43dd7` is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `purchase_deal_id` | the deal reference of the delivered fleet deal, as returned by the purchase deal lookup for the verified customer | identifier |
| `billing_month` | the calendar month the fee is assessed for | YYYY-MM: a 4-digit year, a hyphen and a 2-digit month from 01 to 12, with no day part and no time zone |
| `fee_amount` | the late balance fee | US dollars, greater than zero, 2 decimal places; any further digits are rounded half up to the cent, and the rounded amount is what is posted |

**Return.** A string that starts with "Late balance fee posted" means the charge was booked. It shows the charge reference, the deal reference, the charge code late_balance_fee, the billing month, the amount, the charge date (the handling date) and the deal's new balance due. A string that starts with "Error:" means the month was not in YYYY-MM form or the amount was not greater than zero, and nothing was booked.
